title: Coffee chat about sensors
summary: You met Sam, who builds sleep trackers, and talked about battery life on wearables. Sam offered to send a paper on low-power microphones.
follow_ups: Sam will send a paper on low-power microphones

turns.text: Hi, I'm Sam. I work on sleep trackers.
Nice to meet you, Sam. How do you keep the battery alive all night?
Mostly by keeping the microphone off. I can send you a paper on low-power microphones.
Yes please, that would help a lot.

title: Hallway intro

turns.text: Are you going to the demo session at four?
I think so. Which room is it in?
The big one upstairs. See you there.
